faqs.q: What should a simple lead tracker include?
faqs.a: Who they are (name, email, company), where they came from, the stage, the deal size, when you last spoke and when to follow up next. The next follow-up date matters most, because it tells you who to write to today. [How to build a simple CRM without code](/guides/how-to-build-a-simple-crm-without-code) goes through the fields and stages.

faqs.q: How does it know which emails are leads?
faqs.a: Closer reads the last day of email and picks out new people asking to buy, asking for a quote or filling in your website form. It looks each one up by email first so nobody is added twice, and it never replies to them.

faqs.q: Will it email my leads without asking me?
faqs.a: No. Every follow-up waits in Needs you until you approve it. If you tell Captain you only want reminders, it never drafts an email.

faqs.q: Does it sync with HubSpot or another CRM?
faqs.a: No. It is its own tracker, and a file import keeps one lead per email address. If you already live in a CRM, an AI agent that works on your deals there is a better fit.

faqs.q: Does a lead land the moment their email arrives?
faqs.a: No. Closer reads your Gmail once each weekday at 9:00, so a new lead shows up the next morning at the latest. [How to automate lead follow-up from Gmail](/guides/how-to-automate-lead-follow-up-from-gmail) covers the follow-up loop.

faqs.q: Can Gmail work as a CRM?
faqs.a: Not on its own. Gmail has no field for a lead's stage, deal size or next follow-up date, which a tracker keeps on one row per lead. Closer reads your Gmail each weekday at 9:00 and adds the new leads there.

faqs.q: What does it cost to start?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Tell Captain you want to track leads, read the plan, and tap Build it.

faqs.q: What if it adds someone who is not a lead?
faqs.a: Open the record and change it or remove it. Closer learns from your corrections, so it gets better at spotting who is asking to buy.

faqs.q: How do I stop it emailing a lead?
faqs.a: Every email to a lead waits in Needs you, so declining a draft stops it. Tell Captain to change the quiet period if 3 days is too soon.
